title: The report design: an RDL layout that reads the dataset and the platform parameters
instruction: Ground with get_knowledge(topic="rdl-design-expressions"). In the sandbox model scaffold a full SSRS report (TmpTable + contract + DP + controller + AxReport) and check its DESIGN, not only its X++. The design is stored as an XML type - i:type="AxReportPrecisionDesign" - and its RDL must read the dataset through =Fields!<Column>.Value and show the legal entity through =Parameters!AX_CompanyName.Value. The six platform parameters (AX_CompanyName, AX_UserContext, AX_RenderingCulture, AX_ReportContext, AX_PartitionKey, and AX_RdpPreProcessedId on a pre-processed report) are supplied by the framework: declaring or passing them FAILS this case. Group totals belong in the design as =Sum(Fields!<Column>.Value), not in the DP - aggregating in both double-counts. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
